raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Advance `.main.commit` and the Megatron-LM gitlink from `07046cc6b8b7479ba05e6b47ed25f3f8e6634573` to `9131593673d037d360d252904f9198d36bc0c246`. The dev pin is unchanged.

[Upstream comparison](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/compare/07046cc6b8b7479ba05e6b47ed25f3f8e6634573...9131593673d037d360d252904f9198d36bc0c246) includes MFSDP sharding/shared-layer MTP fixes, GDN decode kernels, DSA KPool/precision controls, routing replay, and batch-invariant kernel fixes. No dependency metadata changes or Bridge compatibility repairs were required during preparation; generated `uv.lock` is unchanged.

Validation: Linux/CUDA container `uv lock` and `uv lock --check` passed (345 packages), all-file pre-commit passed, and pin equality, unchanged dev pin, and `git diff --check` passed. Base main CICD NeMo run 38682975324 passed.

Requested CI: full L0/L1/L2 on H100 and GB200 with `needs-more-tests` and `full-test-suite`. Validated on head `82e3ec561b2e062ccb7f809d5fdf4da92c77f25a`: [CICD NeMo 38696335241](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/actions/runs/38696335241), attempt 1, passed four unit jobs and all 120 functional jobs (H100: L0 30, L1 27, L2 17; GB200: L0 12, L1 21, L2 13). Configure confirmed all four full-suite flags true. All standard gates passed. Build/release run 38696335643 passed on attempt 2 after one failed-job retry for a temporary-file rename ENOENT while installing unchanged FlashInfer cubins. This was a runner filesystem failure; no upstream MCore PR is implicated and the code-bug taxonomy does not apply.

Merged through the authorized pin-only merge helper after all checks passed; merge commit `d86a5c09bbff297132326812289693122240b12b`.
